_note: Frozen before the first demo call. Endpoint, key file and request equal config/gate_run.json apart from a smaller output cap, and src/agent_run.py refuses to run when they differ. Rules below are written before any concept answer exists. Budget, cache and logs are this stage's own, under runs/agent.

pricing_source.row_used: Standard tier, short context, per 1M tokens

panel.source: runs/stage3/key.csv C1 rows: the gate's 300 test split respondents, stratified by age band and sex with largest remainder

pilot.why: A negative control the cheap model cannot separate stops the run before the main spend. Pilot calls are cached and reused by the full run.

planning.why: Mean tokens per call from smoke on a card that is not part of the demo. Expected cost is calls times these means. The cost cap is expected times safety_factor, and the runner stops at it.

rules.metric: t2b_pp: 100 x (p4 + p5) after normalising the five values, per persona, unweighted. It is a panel internal value and never a market number.
rules.noise: noise_upper = larger absolute limit of the bootstrap interval of the mean paired difference A minus A_para, per model. Only one paraphrase is run, so it is assumed to hold for the other candidates.
rules.gap: A candidate pair is distinguishable only if the absolute mean paired difference exceeds noise_upper and its interval excludes zero. Otherwise it is 구분 불가.
rules.negative_control: A candidate is separated from N only if the mean paired difference exceeds noise_upper and the interval lies wholly above zero. A segment where any candidate is not separated is 무효 for that candidate.
rules.brand: The brand effect A_brand minus A exceeds noise only if the absolute mean exceeds noise_upper and the interval excludes zero. Then absolute values are hidden for that model.
rules.model_disagreement: Any candidate pair whose mean paired difference has opposite signs in the two models raises its measurement priority.
rules.c0: 개인 정보가 일을 하지 않음 is flagged when the C0 order of candidates equals the C1 order and every pair's C1 gap minus C0 gap is within noise_upper. C0 uses calls_per_card calls per card on the main model only.
rules.base_label: The v2 labels of the card's anchor items for this model and condition, stored in results/stage3/verdict_v2.json and recomputed with verdict_v2.item_verdict. The lowest wins. No concept can reach 보정 후 참고 before real answers exist.
rules.pilot_gate: Stop before the full run if the pilot's interval of A minus N is not wholly above zero.
